items.headline: Dorsey, McCrary power Georgia State over Northern Illinois 35-14
items.description: — Rodshaun Dorsey caught five passes for 114 yards and two touchdowns, Lanear McCrary Jr. rushed for 111 yards and one touchdown, and Georgia State defeated Northern Illinois 35-14 on Saturday.
